title: QA Analyst Enterprise Applications
description: The group you’ll be a part of The Global Information Systems Group is dedicated to the success of Lam through providing best-in-class and innovative information system solutions and services. Together, we support users globally with data, information, and systems to achieve their business objectives. The impact you’ll make Role Overview The QA Analyst Enterprise Applications is a fully hands-on performance testing role responsible for planning, scripting, executing, analyzing, and reporting performance tests for complex enterprise applications. The role requires deep, current expertise in OpenText LoadRunner, particularly Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, and TruClient 2.0 protocols, together with strong knowledge of C-based scripting, correlation, parameterization, custom requests, and performance diagnostics. The analyst will work directly with product owners, development teams, functional teams, infrastructure and platform teams, database administrators, application support teams, and business stakeholders to translate non-functional requirements into realistic workload models and actionable performance evidence. The role requires agility in moving scripts across environments, maintaining scripts through frequent application and environment upgrades, and meeting demanding What you’ll do Key Responsibilities Own the end-to-end performance testing lifecycle: requirements, NFR validation, strategy, workload modelling, scripting, execution, monitoring, analysis, defect mgt, reporting. Develop, debug, maintain LoadRunner VuGen scripts (Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, TruClient 2.0); independently resolve correlation, session, authentication, replay issues. Build stable, maintainable scripts using HTTP/HTTPS functions, C, parameterization, correlation, validations, error handling, reusable libraries. Design realistic load, stress, endurance, volume, scalability, spike, capacity scenarios in LoadRunner Controller/ Enterprise Engg/ Performance Center. Adapt scripts to changes in environments, endpoints, certificates, authentication, applications, applying modular design, naming standards, version control. Gather business volumes, concurrency, transaction mix, response-time targets; translate them into workload models,acceptance criteria. Monitor client- and server-side metrics,correlate user experience with application, web/API, database, middleware, infrastructure behavior Analyze results, logs, percentiles, throughput, errors, and resource utilization to identify bottlenecks recommend improvements Partner with product owners and technical teams on scope, environment readiness, dependencies, risks, timelines; escalate blockers Document test plans, scripts, results, defects, findings, residual risks in approved platforms; support defect triage, tuning, retesting, release-readiness reviews. Role Requirements Performance Testing & LoadRunner Strong hands-on LoadRunner exp, including current or recent Web HTTP/HTML protocol exp. Hands-on expertise with Web HTTP/HTML, SAP, TruClient 2.0; Web Services/API expdesirable. Advanced VuGen scripting manual correlation, parameterization, custom requests, dynamic values, tokens, C functions, reusable libraries, error handling. Strong knowledge of LoadRunner Controller and/or Enterprise Performance Engineering/Center. Ability to independently troubleshoot recording/replay failures, certificates/proxies, authentication, session handling, script instability. Experience designing load, stress, endurance, spike, volume, scalability, capacity tests based on business ,release risk. Performance Analysis & Monitoring Strong ability to analyze client- and server-side metrics and correlate findings across application and infrastructure layers. Experience with AppDynamics, Splunk, SiteScope, PerfMon, Wily/Introscope, VisualVM. Knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, load balancers, web/application servers, APIs, DB, OS metrics. Ability to interpret percentiles, throughput, error rates,,, GC, thread/connection pools, database waits. Planning, Collaboration & Delivery Ability to create practical test strategies, estimate effort, manage dependencies, deliver within release timelines. Strong collaboration across product, development, QA, architecture, infrastructure, security, business teams. Ability to challenge incomplete NFRs, align stakeholders on scope, workloads, success criteria. Ability to manage multiple assignments and changing priorities with minimal supervision. Who we’re looking for Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum 7 years of dedicated performance testing experience using LoadRunner, including substantial recent hands-on Web HTTP/HTML scripting. Experience testing enterprise SaaS and custom applications, integrated business processes, APIs, SAP solutions, and multi-tier application architectures. Experience working in Agile and DevOps delivery models and using Azure DevOps, Jira, or comparable platforms for backlog, defect, evidence, and release tracking. Experience using Git or another version-control system for performance-test scripts and supporting assets. Preferred qualifications Experience with JMeter, NeoLoad, or comparable performance testing tools in addition to LoadRunner. Experience with SAP GUI, web-based SAP applications, APIs, data-intensive applications, batch processes, or enterprise integrations. Experience with cloud-hosted applications and performance testing in Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud environments. Knowledge of CI/CD integration for performance tests, automated smoke or baseline execution, trend reporting, and quality gates. title: IT Business Analyst
description: At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds. As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised. What You Can Expect The IT Business Analyst is a key partner to the business, supporting technology-enabled improvement across the medical device organization. Based in India and working as part of a global IT team, this role supports the Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, and Engineering Services functions by bridging business needs with compliant, practical, and scalable technology solutions. The IT Business Analyst gathers and documents business requirements, maps current- and future-state processes, and translates business needs into clear functional specifications and user stories. The role supports project delivery, testing, and deployment activities, and works closely with business subject matter experts (SMEs), IT Senior Analysts, application support teams, and vendors to ensure solutions meet operational, regulatory, and quality expectations. Work Location: Bangalore Work Mode: Hybrid(3 Days in office) How You'll Create Impact Requirements & Process Analysis Elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs. Develop current-state and future-state process maps for Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs and Engineering Services processes using standard modelling techniques and tools. Translate business needs into clear user stories, functional specifications, use cases, and acceptance criteria. Perform gap analysis between current system capabilities and business needs, and recommend opportunities for improvement. Maintain requirements traceability from business need through design, testing, and deployment. Solution Support & Design Partner with IT Senior Analysts, solution architects, developers, and vendors to support the design of solutions aligned with enterprise standards and the ZB technology ecosystem. Research and evaluate software products, enhancements, and configuration options, and provide recommendations and effort estimates. Support solution designs that maintain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements (eg:FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU MDR, ISO 13485, GxP) and data privacy obligations (eg:GDPR, India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act). Support application enhancements, upgrades, and integrations across the QA/RA, Clinical, and Engineering Services application portfolio (e.g., PLM, QMS, CAD/CAE, and clinical and regulatory systems). Project Delivery, Testing & Validation Support the development and maintenance of project plans, including scope, milestones, deliverables, resources, and dependencies. Support project delivery by tracking tasks, timelines, risks, issues, and status for assigned IT initiatives. Support the documentation of technical delivery, including technical specifications, system configuration and design documents, interface specifications, and deployment/cutover plans. Prepare and execute test scenarios and scripts; coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), defect logging, and triage. Contribute to computer system validation (CSV/CSA) deliverables and ensure documentation meets GxP, data integrity, and Zimmer Biomet quality standards. Support go-live readiness, deployment, organizational change management (OCM), and post-go-live hypercare activities. Stakeholder Engagement & Business Support Act as an IT point of contact for Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, and Engineering Services stakeholders, building strong working relationships across global teams and time zones. Support the identification, assessment, and timely remediation of system vulnerabilities (e.g., security patches, version upgrades, configuration hardening) in partnership with IT Security, infrastructure teams, and vendors to ensure the security and compliance of supported systems. Analyze escalated application issues, identify root causes and recurring trends, and work with support teams and vendors to drive resolution. Develop end-user training materials, job aids, and knowledge articles (e.g., in ServiceNow), and support training sessions and user reviews of new or modified systems. Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and improve data quality and reporting. Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies (including AI-enabled tools), and regulatory developments relevant to IT in the medical device industry. Contribute to business analysis best practices, templates, and knowledge assets. This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions. Responsibilities may be modified or expanded based on business needs. What Makes You Stand Out Understanding of business processes within Quality Management Systems (QMS), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, and/or Engineering/R&D (e.g., document control, CAPA, complaint handling, change control, product data management). Exposure to enterprise systems such as Windchill (PLM), EtQ (QMS), SOP/document management tools, CAD/CAE applications (e.g., NX, SolidWorks), or clinical and regulatory information systems. Awareness of IT security and vulnerability management practices in support of secure, compliant systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail. Ability to work effectively with global, cross-functional teams, including flexibility to support meetings with colleagues in the Americas and Europe. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results against project deadlines. Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery methods and ITIL service management practices. ECBA, CCBA, or other IIBA certification, Agile/Scrum certification, or ITIL Foundation is a plus. Self-motivated, customer-service oriented, and eager to learn and take ownership. Your Background Education Bachelor’s degree (e.g., B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field is required. Master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MCA, M.Tech) is a plus. Experience 2–5 years of experience in IT business analysis, systems analysis, application support, or a related technology role. Experience supporting Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, or Engineering business functions in a medical device or life sciences environment is preferred. A combination of education and experience will be considered. Language Excellent written and spoken English communication skills are required, including the ability to present, facilitate workshops, and write clear documentation for global audiences, translating technical concepts into business language and vice versa. Technical Proficiency Working knowledge of requirements management and process modelling tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps). Familiarity with data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, SQL) is a plus. Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Teams). Physical Requirements Travel Expectations Up to 10%, including occasional international travel to support global projects. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

No prior work experience is expected — we will train you. Explore how analytics, machine learning, and AI can detect data anomalies, predict failures, and improve supply chain decisions. The role will support both new IT initiatives and enhancements, as well as continuous improvement and runtime operations. Key Responsibilities • Perform business analysis, requirement elicitation, requirement documentation, gap analysis, and impact analysis. • Analyze and document functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, process flows, use cases, and acceptance criteria. • Work closely with business stakeholders and end users to understand business needs, pain points, and expected outcomes. • Translate business requirements into clear requirements/user stories for development and technical teams. • Facilitate requirement discussions, workshops, walkthroughs, and clarification sessions with business and IT stakeholders. • Support solution assessment and impact analysis across applications, integrations, processes, and dependent systems. • Manage requirements and backlog using Jira and Confluence, ensuring traceability from requirements through implementation. • Support Agile delivery, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirement clarification, demos, and acceptance activities. • Support testing activities by reviewing test scenarios/test cases, ensuring adequate requirement coverage and quality. • Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including business-user coordination, defect clarification, and acceptance. • Work closely with end users and IT teams for runtime/operational support, including analysis and classification of functional versus technical issues. • Work with ServiceNow/ITSM processes for incident, request, problem, and change-related activities as applicable. • Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and continuous improvement to minimize user disruption and operational inefficiencies. • Create and maintain clear process documentation, knowledge articles, user guides, training material, and supporting videos. • Collaborate effectively across business, development, QA, operations, architecture, and other cross-functional teams. Required Skills & Competencies • Minimum 6+ years of Business Analysis experience in IT/software projects. • Strong experience in requirement elicitation, functional analysis, gap/impact analysis, and non-functional requirement analysis. • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycle. • Ability to understand business problems and distinguish between business/functional and technical issues. • Experience working directly with business stakeholders and end users. • Good understanding of testing lifecycle, UAT, test cases, and defect management. • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work across business and technical teams. • Ability to influence and drive change collaboratively across stakeholders. Must-Have Tools • Jira • Confluence • ServiceNow • MS Office – Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook • SharePoint Good to Have • Experience in the Automotive / Commercial Vehicle / Manufacturing industry. • Exposure to Connected Vehicle / Telematics / Digital Services environments. • Understanding of cloud technologies such as Azure and AWS. • Exposure to DevSecOps tools and practices. • Experience with visualization/reporting tools such as Power BI or Qlik Sense. • Experience working with geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
